# Matthew Cuthbert

## Overview

- **Age:** Sixty years old  <sub>[v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c2 P12](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0012)</sub>
- **Status:** Deceased  <sub>[v1 c37 P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009), [v1 c37 P11](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0011)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer  <sub>[v1 c2 P0](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0000), [v1 c19 P24](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0024), [v1 c37 P2](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0002)</sub>

## Appearance

Matthew is an odd-looking person with an ungainly figure and stooping shoulders. He has long iron-gray hair that touches his shoulders and has worn a full, soft brown beard since he was twenty years old.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)_

## Personality

Matthew is exceptionally shy, quiet, and uncomfortable around strangers and women, with the exception of Marilla and Mrs. Rachel Lynde. Though soft-spoken, he holds fast to his opinions once formed and displays deep gentleness, generosity, and quiet understanding toward Anne.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c2 P12](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0012), [v1 c19 P24](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0024), [v1 c19 P31](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0031), [v1 c37 P10](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0010)_

## Traits

- Shy and timid around women  <sub>[v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c2 P12](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0012), [v1 c25 P24](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0024)</sub>
- Firm and steadfast in his opinions  <sub>[v1 c19 P24](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0024)</sub>
- Gentle and sympathetic  <sub>[v1 c2 P17](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0017), [v1 c19 P31](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0031)</sub>
- Fear of women secretly laughing at him  <sub>[v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)</sub>

## Abilities

- Farming and driving  <sub>[v1 c2 P0](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0000), [v1 c2 P19](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0019)</sub>

## Goals

- Adopt a child to help at Green Gables  <sub>[v1 c2 P7](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0007), [v1 c2 P9](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0009)</sub>
- Ensure Anne's happiness and see her dressed nicely  <sub>[v1 c19 P24](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0024), [v1 c25 P24](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0024), [v1 c25 P26](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0026)</sub>

## History

Matthew Cuthbert travels to Bright River station expecting to pick up an orphan boy sent from Nova Scotia by Mrs. Alexander Spencer to assist on the farm. Upon arrival, he discovers a young red-headed orphan girl named Anne Shirley waiting instead, but decides to take her home to Green Gables to let his sister Marilla resolve the mistake. Matthew quickly develops a quiet affection and understanding for Anne, advocating for her to attend events such as the Avonlea concert despite Marilla's initial hesitations. Wanting Anne to have nice clothing like other girls, he attempts to buy dress fabric at a local store, but his extreme shyness leads him to accidentally purchase a garden rake and twenty pounds of brown sugar before enlisting Mrs. Rachel Lynde's help to make a puffed-sleeved dress. Tragically, Matthew passes away suddenly from a heart attack at Green Gables after reading a newspaper account announcing the sudden failure of the Abbey Bank.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P4](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0004), [v1 c2 P7](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0007), [v1 c2 P9](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0009), [v1 c2 P17](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0017), [v1 c19 P24](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0024), [v1 c19 P31](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0031), [v1 c25 P9](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0009), [v1 c25 P16](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0016), [v1 c25 P24](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0024), [v1 c25 P26](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0026), [v1 c37 P1](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0001), [v1 c37 P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009)_

## Background by volume

- Has worn a full brown beard since the age of twenty  <sub>[v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)</sub>
- Resided at the Green Gables homestead with his sister Marilla  <sub>[v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c2 P17](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0017), [v1 c37 P11](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0011)</sub>

## Quotes

> I’m not expecting a girl. It’s a boy I’ve come for. He should be here. Mrs. Alexander Spencer was to bring him over from Nova Scotia for me.  <sub>[v1 c2 P7](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0007)</sub>

> I’m sorry I was late. Come along. The horse is over in the yard. Give me your bag.  <sub>[v1 c2 P18](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0018)</sub>

> Well now, I ain’t interfering. It ain’t interfering to have your own opinion. And my opinion is that you ought to let Anne go.  <sub>[v1 c19 P22](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0022)</sub>

> Well now—if it isn’t too much trouble—I might as well—that is—I’d like to look at—at—some sugar.  <sub>[v1 c25 P16](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0016)</sub>

> Well now, I’m much obliged, and—and—I dunno—but I’d like—I think they make the sleeves different nowadays to what they used to be. If it wouldn’t be asking too much I—I’d like them made in the new way.  <sub>[v1 c25 P26](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0026)</sub>
